description: Map IP ranges or hostnames to identities via a TOML config file. Implements IdentityProvider. identify_caller matches ctx.peer_addr against configured CIDR ranges or exact IPs and returns the associated Identity. Useful for LAN deployments, dev/test, and Headscale setups with non-Tailscale IP ranges. Minimal implementation — exercises the trait with no external dependencies.
title: Identity provider: static config file
